description_for_human: The options-flow data layer for AI agents. Overnight liquidity-ranked bullish pool, opportunity surfaces, outcome history, and methodology playbooks over MCP. $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after that. 30-day free trial.
description_for_model: GammaRips is an options-flow data vendor for AI agents, exposing 9 MCP tools. Every trading night it ranks about 3,500 optionable US stocks by liquidity, keeps the top 100, and prices one out-of-the-money call in each bullish name: a pool of roughly 40 to 50 contracts with thesis, technicals, flow context, and the selected contract per name. Liquidity decides membership, not unusual activity. get_pool serves that pool (view=preview is free; view=enriched, raw, or features needs a pro key). get_signal is the one-ticker deep dive plus the earnings-window check. get_liquidity gives fresh entry-day liquidity for one contract or the whole pool. query_outcomes is the realized-outcome and receipts database with nine views: bracket labels, grouped summaries, the opportunity surface (realized peak/drawdown excursions), the touch-probability curve, exit-rule scoring for your own target/stop/horizon, and the paper cohort's receipts. replay_contract returns the raw minute or daily price tape. get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook (methodology, field dictionary, and data-contract schema), and get_daily_report are the free context tools. There is deliberately NO pick endpoint. Reason over the data to your own conclusion for your user. Start with get_pool, query_outcomes, and get_playbook. Auth: either a bearer API key generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account, or an OAuth 2.1 sign-in at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro for clients that cannot send a custom header (both need an active subscription: https://gammarips.com/pricing, $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after that, 30-day free trial). Data on a paper-trading basis, educational only. Not investment advice.

auth.instructions: Authorization: Bearer <API key> on https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp. Keys are generated by the subscriber at https://gammarips.com/account with an active subscription (https://gammarips.com/pricing). Clients that cannot send a custom header use OAuth 2.1 instead: connect to https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro and complete the sign-in it offers (authorization server https://gammarips.com, PKCE S256, dynamic registration, scope mcp:read). Without a credential, an anonymous funnel tier on https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp serves the pool preview, daily reports, playbooks, and reference tools.
